func otelSeverityTextToDataSetSeverity(sevText string, defaultSeverityLevel int) int {
	switch strings.ToLower(sevText) {
	case "fine", "finest":
		return 0
	case "trace":
		return 1
	case "debug":
		return 2
	case "info", "information":
		return 3
	case "warn", "warning":
		return 4
	case "error":
		return 5
	case "fatal", "critical", "emergency":
		return 6
	default:
		return defaultSeverityLevel
	}
}
